dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Today, we're going to make predictions about the future. Nam, where will you be living in ten years?
dialogue.reading: təˈdeɪ, wɪr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈmeɪk prɪˈdɪkʃənz əˈbaʊt ðə ˈfjuːtʃər. ˈnɑːm, ˈwɛr wɪl juː bi ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn ˈtɛn ˈjɪrz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I think I'll be living in Bangkok, but in a bigger apartment!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk aɪl bi ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, bʌt ɪn ə ˈbɪɡər əˈpɑːrtmənt!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And what will you be doing this time next year?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt wɪl juː bi ˈduːɪŋ ðɪs ˈtaɪm ˈnɛkst ˈjɪr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: This time next year, I'll be studying in Toronto, I hope.
dialogue.reading: ðɪs ˈtaɪm ˈnɛkst ˈjɪr, aɪl bi ˈstʌdiɪŋ ɪn təˈrɑːntoʊ, aɪ ˈhoʊp.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great. Now, let's think bigger. What will people be doing in 2050?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ˈnaʊ, lɛts ˈθɪŋk ˈbɪɡər. ˈwʌt wɪl ˈpiːpəl bi ˈduːɪŋ ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈfɪfti?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Nowadays, most people work in offices. But in a few decades, most of us will be working from home.
dialogue.reading: ˈnaʊədeɪz, ˈmoʊst ˈpiːpəl ˈwɜːrk ɪn ˈɔːfɪsɪz. bʌt ɪn ə ˈfjuː ˈdɛkeɪdz, ˈmoʊst əv ʌs wɪl bi ˈwɜːrkɪŋ frəm ˈhoʊm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Interesting. Can anyone predict how we'll be traveling?
dialogue.reading: ˈɪntrəstɪŋ. kən ˈɛniwʌn prɪˈdɪkt ˈhaʊ wiːl bi ˈtrævəlɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In the near future, we'll be riding electric buses everywhere.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ðə ˈnɪr ˈfjuːtʃər, wiːl bi ˈraɪdɪŋ ɪˈlɛktrɪk ˈbʌsɪz ˈɛvriwɛr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's already happening in Bangkok, isn't it?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈhæpənɪŋ ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, ˈɪzənt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, a little. But in 2050, there won't be any gasoline cars at all.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ə ˈlɪtəl. bʌt ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈfɪfti, ðɛr ˈwoʊnt bi ˈɛni ˈɡæsəliːn ˈkɑːrz ət ˈɔːl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And you, Mr. Brown, will be enjoying your retirement on a beach!
dialogue.reading: ənd juː, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn, wɪl bi ɪnˈdʒɔɪɪŋ jʊr rɪˈtaɪərmənt ɑːn ə ˈbiːtʃ!
